method: Anonymous PL/SQL blocks executed against the real Oracle reference server; numeric output via TO_CHAR.

numeric.source: DECLARE c CONSTANT NUMBER := 1 / 3; BEGIN :out := TO_CHAR(c); END;

boolean.source: DECLARE c CONSTANT BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE; BEGIN IF c THEN :out := 'true'; ELSE :out := 'false'; END IF; END;
